newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Yeebo rescue plan to reach banks this week.
newsitem.headline: Yeebo rescue plan to reach banks this week.

text.p: Liquid crystal display maker Yeebo (International Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it would submit a recapitalisation plan to its bankers by Thursday at the latest.
Yeebo said it owed about HK$251 million to nine banks.
It said its directors "have been actively negotiating recapitalisation plans with various potential investors" and "four written proposals have been received by the company."

Yeebo said National Bank of Canada had demanded a HK$23 million repayment on the maturation of a HK$123 million syndicated loan on September 2, but the bank would not take any legal action pending receipt of the recapitalisation plan.
Trading in Yeebo shares has been suspended since March 19.
